jobs.title: Program Manager (100% Remote)
jobs.description:
Since our founding in 2011, our mission has been to improve the lives of seniors and their caregivers. We are deeply passionate about communication and committed to becoming the foremost provider of services and solutions that enable seniors to lead more meaningful and independent lives. We also understand the power of connection and the profound impact it has on the lives of individuals who are hard-of-hearing. By utilizing enhanced automatic speech recognition, human captioning, and innovative product development, we deliver easy-to-use, cutting-edge technology to our primarily senior customer base. Our near real-time phone captioning technology allows individuals with hearing loss to see what callers are saying, enabling them to regain their connection to the world.

ClearCaptions is a Federal Communications Commission (FCC)-certified telephone captioning provider, adhering to the highest industry standards of privacy, security, and professionalism. We recognize the importance of maintaining the trust and confidence of our customers, and we continually strive to exceed their expectations.

For more information about our services please visit clearcaptions.com.

The kind of people we look for:

Versatile people who thrive on variety and challenge
Excited about working in a fast-paced environment.
Innate problem solvers who want to grow in a flexible, collaborative culture.
Takes initiative, pushes boundaries, motivated to innovate.
Individuals with a growth mindset who want to use their learning and relationship-building skills.
Align with our company core values: Integrity, Accountability, Collaboration, Service and Quality.

Summary:

The Program Manager will support executive sponsors, business owners, and product leaders in delivering strategic programs that achieve key organizational goals and objectives. The Program Manager will lead complex, cross-functional programs that span multiple business units and consist of multiple interdependent projects. This role ensures alignment between business strategy, product development, and technical execution across the full product lifecycle. This role will oversee program planning, integrated delivery, financial management, and governance, ensuring adherence to SDLC, Agile methodologies, and Stage Gate controls. Responsibilities include managing cross-team dependencies, risks, issues, and program-level changes to ensure successful delivery of products, platforms, and services. The Program Manager will also contribute to continuous improvement initiatives to enhance delivery capabilities across the organization.

What This Role Does:

Leads end-to-end program management across multiple related projects, ensuring alignment to strategic business objectives.
Develops and maintains integrated program plans, including schedules, milestones, dependencies, and resource allocation.
Oversees product development lifecycle stages, ensuring readiness and approval at each phase (Stage Gate governance).
Manages program financials, including budgeting, forecasting, and tracking (CapEx/OpEx).
Manages capacity, resource constraints, and competing priorities across projects within the program.
Drives program decision making and alignment with the business ensuring compliance regulation is met across projects.
Matrix management of project managers.
Prepares operational readiness plan to ensure sustained adoption across the organization as projects are implemented.
Drives project delivery of project milestones in alignment with strategy plan.
Supports Strategy Business Partner with vendor management pertinent to the programs.
Collaborates closely with the Strategy Business Partner, Stakeholders, and Project teams.
Partners with Product Managers and Business Owners to support the development, deployment, and delivery of product and service.
Collaborates with engineering, architecture, and IT teams to ensure coordinated execution across technical workstreams.
Identifies and manages cross-team dependencies, ensuring alignment across multiple functions and teams.
Monitors program health through KPIs and performance metrics, providing regular reporting to senior leadership and stakeholders.
Leads risk, issue, and escalation management, including diagnosing challenges and driving resolution strategies.
Drives operational readiness and change management efforts to support successful implementation and adoption.
Provides cross-functional leadership and influence to achieve program objectives without direct authority.
Ensures programs are delivered within scope, budget, and timeline constraints.
Oversees deployment and integration activities, ensuring successful product release and adoption.
Contributes to the development and maturity of PMO methodologies, tools, templates, and governance frameworks.
Promotes continuous improvement, identifying opportunities to increase efficiency, innovation, and delivery effectiveness.
Performs other duties as assigned.

What You Will Bring:

A bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, business, or related field is required; a master’s degree in business administration or project management is preferred. Equivalent combinations of education and relevant experience will be considered.
A minimum of eight (8) years of experience in program management, project management, or technical delivery roles, with emphasis on technology and product development is required, 10 years is preferred.
A minimum of three (3) years of most recent experience managing programs in the telecom industry in one of the following areas: mobile, IoT devices, telephony services.
Demonstrated experience managing complex, cross-functional programs across multiple teams and business units.
Demonstrate ability to manage more than one program simultaneously.
Strong knowledge of:
Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)
Agile methodologies and tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence)
Stage Gate / execution governance frameworks

Proven ability to manage program budgets, financials, and resource planning.
Excellent facilitation and leadership skills, with the ability to drive alignment across business and technical stakeholders.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to diagnose and resolve technical and operational issues.
Experience defining, tracking, and reporting program performance metrics.
Experience leading programs involving:
Telecom Transformation Programs
Infrastructure Programs
Cloud Migrations

Demonstrated ability to lead through influence and collaboration, including mentoring others, leading initiatives or workstreams, contributing to best practices, and driving cross-functional outcomes.
Strong communication and presentation skills across all levels of the organization including executive communication.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and modern collaboration platforms (e.g., MS Teams, Slack).
Self-starter with strong organizational and time management skills, capable of handling multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to work collaboratively to foster a results-driven, team-oriented environment.
Demonstrated ability to use discretion, make sound decisions, and maintain confidentiality.
Willingness and ability to work flexible hours as needed and travel up to 10%, which may include occasional overnight travel.

Preferred:

Experience working as a Project Manager, Business Analyst or Business Systems Analyst.
Experience in telecommunications and/or compliance-driven environments.
Active PMP or PgMP certification (PMI).
Agile training and/or certification.

Physical Demands:

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws, the Company will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with documented disabilities to enable them to perform the essential functions of the job, unless such accommodations would impose an undue hardship. Employees seeking accommodation should contact the People Department to initiate the interactive process.

Employees may experience the following physical demands for extended periods of time: 

Sitting, standing, and walking (95-100%)
Keyboarding (40-60%)
Viewing computer monitor, tablet, and cell phone requiring close vision (95-100%)

Work Environment:

100% Remote with Travel: Work environment is primarily indoors (home office, customer or vendor sites, or other business meeting venues); travel may involve exposure to varying weather and temperature conditions, as well as driving and traffic hazards. Travel is required, approximately 10%, and may include overnight and out-of-state trips.

Compensation:

$142,000 - $165,000 plus 5% bonus determined by competitive market analysis and internal equity considerations. Final compensation will be based on the candidate’s qualifications, experience, and business needs. For details on our comprehensive benefits program, visit www.clearcaptions.com/careers to explore our total rewards package.

We are ENG, #1 BIM services provider in the United States, specialized in hands‑on, field‑focused Building Information Modeling (BIM) services for large‑scale projects such as data centers, hospitals, airports, industrial plants, schools, casinos, and more. .

Previous electrical design or field installation experience.

(NEC, NFPA, etc.).
Data center or healthcare project experience.
Experience with ACC/BIM 360, Revizto, or similar platforms.
Experience managing remote teams and multiple projects simultaneously.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

Leading electrical BIM teams
across multiple US-based projects
Managing project scope, schedules, budgets, billing, and change orders

Serving as the main client-facing point of contact

Overseeing QA/QC processes
to ensure high-quality deliverables
Coordinating resources, staffing, PTO, and team development

Working closely with Business Unit leadership on planning and strategy
Using tools such as Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC), Revit, Navisworks, and MS Project

Have a strong sense of ownership and a high bar for excellence
Enjoy strategic thinking and creative problem-solving
Are highly organized with excellent time management skills

, where Westinghouse Electric Company is leading the field with expertise and innovation to shape the power of tomorrow. At Westinghouse, innovation is in our DNA. We are creative. We think differently. We reimagine the possible across the nuclear industry every day.

As a Project Manager – Nuclear Decommissioning & Waste Management Projects you will lead mid-sized nuclear decommissioning and radioactive waste management projects in EMEA. You will deliver projects safely, within budget, and in compliance with nuclear industry regulations and quality standards. We ask that you have leadership, partner management skills, and project execution skills in an international environment.

You will report to the D&WM Program Manager Eastern Countries and be located in one of our European entities.

Travels across Europe: up to 50% of your time.

Manage the full lifecycle of nuclear decommissioning and radioactive waste management projects from planning through execution and close-out.
Develop project plans, schedules, budgets, and risk registers.
Coordinate diverse engineering teams, contractors, suppliers, and client representatives.
Ensure compliance with nuclear safety regulations, environmental standards, and company quality management systems.
Monitor project progress, identify risks, and implement mitigation measures.
Manage project scope, cost, schedule, and change control processes.
Present project status reports to senior management and clients.
Support contract management, procurement activities, and commercial negotiations.
Foster communication with partners across multiple European countries.
Promote a safety culture and ensure adherence to Health, Safety, Security, Environment, and Quality (HSSEQ) requirements.

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Project Management, or a related discipline.
PMI Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or an equivalent project management certification
Minimum 5 years of project management experience, preferably in nuclear decommissioning, radioactive waste management, energy, infrastructure, or other regulated industries.
Demonstrated experience managing mid-sized engineering or industrial projects.
Knowledge of project management methodologies, budgeting, scheduling, and risk management.
Fluent English (written and spoken); Spanish or Slovak language skills are an advantage. Willingness to travel approximately 50% of the time throughout Europe.

Preffered

Familiarity with European nuclear regulations and decommissioning practices.
Knowledge of project management software such as Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, or similar tools.

These capabilities guide how all employees contribute to our shared success across Mission Technologies.

Who We Are

HII-Mission Technologies is seeking an Intelligence Analyst to join our Operations Support Team (OST) located at the Ft. Meade and Annapolis Junction, Maryland locations. This critical position is part of a 24/7 Help Desk team of technicians that is required to maintain optimal posture of SIGINT systems across a wide range of AORs. The OST Intelligence Analyst diagnoses, troubleshoots, and rectifies any faults for deployed sensors, and forwards unresolved issues to deployed Field Service Representatives (FSRs) with the correct diagnosis and the steps for repair.

The OST Intelligence Analyst serves as a point of contact for FSRs to gain assistance in troubleshooting deployed systems; provides on-call reach-back capability to mission managers, FSRs and system engineers for deployed assets; and resolves Service Requests (SRs) for system outages and troubleshooting. Additionally, they may be asked to provide onsite support activities for flight test operations at customer facilities. This includes conducting validations, installation of systems on platforms, loading and unloading equipment, monitoring tests on systems, equipment installation and testing, and setting up software servers. This requires travel to the customer facilities for up to two weeks per occurrence.

The OST Help Desk is operational 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Currently there are two modified Panama shifts of 12 hours each; the first shift begins at 6 am and ends at 6 pm. Monitor multiple chatrooms for outages

Maintenance of the outage/troubleshooting database
Identify software or hardware related flaws to engineers

Train other members of the team on SIGINT fundamentals

Versatile people who thrive on variety and challenge
Excited about working in a fast-paced environment.
Innate problem solvers who want to grow in a flexible, collaborative culture.
Takes initiative, pushes boundaries, motivated to innovate.
Individuals with a growth mindset who want to use their learning and relationship-building skills.

Summary:

This role ensures alignment between business strategy, product development, and technical execution across the full product lifecycle. Matrix management of project managers.

Partners with Product Managers and Business Owners to support the development, deployment, and delivery of product and service.

A minimum of eight (8) years of experience in program management, project management, or technical delivery roles, with emphasis on technology and product development is required, 10 years is preferred.

Previous electrical design or field installation experience.

(NEC, NFPA, etc.).
Data center or healthcare project experience.

Experience managing remote teams and multiple projects simultaneously.

across multiple US-based projects

to ensure high-quality deliverables

, Electromechanical Engineers
, or Civil Engineers

, acting as a strategic partner on scope definition, constructability, coordination, and long‑term portfolio growth.
Identify new opportunities and BU growth initiatives
based on market signals and client feedback.

Lead and mentor a 15–30 person BU
, nurturing leaders (PMs, Coordinators, Technical Leaders) and ensuring clear career paths and development plans
for team members.
Collaborate with People Business Partners in recruitment, engagement, retention, and succession planning
.

Ensure the BU has deep, hands‑on expertise
in Revit, Navisworks and other key BIM tools (AutoCAD, BIM 360 / Autodesk Construction Cloud, Bluebeam, Recap or similar).
Promote and sponsor innovation initiatives
that improve constructability, coordination, and productivity in electrical BIM for US projects.

Strong track record in data center or mission‑critical electrical projects
(major differentiator).
Experience collaborating closely with US electrical contractors, GCs, or owners.
Experience with prefabrication, advanced coordination, and constructability‑driven BIM
